headline: Copper Fund Edges Up 0.7% After Fed Hold as Freeport Gains
summary: The United States Copper Index Fund rose 0.70% to $40.33 following the Federal Reserve's rate hold. Miner Freeport-McMoRan gained 0.99%, while Southern Copper slipped 0.27%.
why: Copper is an essential industrial metal widely viewed as a leading indicator of global manufacturing and construction health.

impacts.name: Freeport-McMoRan Inc.
impacts.why: Firm copper fund pricing provided support to major base metal producers.
